# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Iteration cand_0002, parent cand_0001 (val 0.600, 30/50). Diagnosed all 20 failing
trajectories via 4 parallel read-only subagents (groups A–D), separated ENVIRONMENT/logic
faults from capability gaps, then shipped 4 additive/narrowed prose edits across 4 DIFFERENT
lever types. cand_0001's leave-untouched/type/_xlfn additive rules were kept verbatim; this
iteration builds ON them by converting the *skipped* ones into unavoidable checks and adding
new KNOWLEDGE the prompt lacked.

## Ranked issue list (leverage = # failing tasks × recoverable score, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | lever used |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Overwrote given/example cells inside answer_position + skipped named-literal | 39046, 51359, 57232 | Rule EXISTS (cand_0001) but agent skips it — recomputes/overwrites whole range; writes 0 instead of the named "#N/A" literal | SKIPPED-STEP | STRUCTURE: pre-finish checklist (precondition of finishing) |
| 2 | Live formula fails grader recalc → error string | 38332, 47741 | Formula references spilled UNIQUE/SORT arrays, or is a nested TEXTJOIN/TEXT-over-WORKDAY; LibreOffice can't recalc → #N/A/#NAME written out, expected a plain number | KNOWLEDGE gap | New recalc-failure fact + "compute literal" |
| 3 | Extracted substring typed as date/number, expected text | 50630 | "Split sentence into parts" → agent parsed the date-looking piece into datetime; every split piece should stay text | KNOWLEDGE/CONTRACT | New default-type rule for split/extract |
| 4 | Over-fit an inconsistent worked example → truncated answer | 5192 | Agent added a heuristic to reproduce one example cell that contradicts the literal rule, dropping characters the rule keeps → "PREFIX, cut short" | CONFLICT/adherence | Clause: follow literal rule when example contradicts it |
| — | ENVIRONMENT fault (handed back, NOT fixed) | 73-45, 56996 | 73-45 recalc failed (INFRASTRUCTURE, stale cached values); 56996 source cells are volatile =RANDBETWEEN → non-deterministic, cannot match gold by construction | — | none — prompt is not the defect |
| — | Ambiguous / inconsistent-gold / isolated logic (SKIPPED) | 325-44, 3911, 53367, 59743, 57090, 55931, 56637, 56427, 11842, 450-9-bulk, 51958 | multiple-valid-solution ordering/allocation; boolean-vs-count; self-contradictory instruction; per-year-vs-global dedup; entrant/dropout semantics; multi-region under-spec; transpose-type conflicts with pass-through-preserve; 2/96 logic edge; row-count divergence | — | none — no safe prose fix; a rule would be a guess and risk regressions |

## Changes made this iteration (4 edits, 4 distinct lever types)
| # | cluster | lever | file | what & why it generalizes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | rank 1 | STRUCTURE (checklist / precondition) | task_template.md (verification step 3) | Replaced the one-line "confirm cells filled" with a 3-item pre-finish checklist: (a) type & completeness, (b) NO COLLATERAL CHANGES — reopen ORIGINAL input, diff over answer_position, revert any given/example cell you overwrote (fill/compute tasks only, restructure excluded), (c) NAMED LITERALS — confirm "#N/A"/"-"/blank cases hold the exact literal, not 0. Makes the already-present-but-skipped rules a precondition of finishing. |
| 2 | rank 2 | KNOWLEDGE | task_template.md (formula section) | New bullet: a live formula scores only if recalc resolves it; recalc is unreliable for dynamic-array funcs (UNIQUE/SORT/FILTER/SEQUENCE), for formulas referencing cells holding such spilled results, and for deeply nested modern-function formulas (TEXTJOIN/TEXT-over-WORKDAY) → compute the LITERAL value when the answer is a plain number/date/text. |
| 3 | rank 3 | KNOWLEDGE/CONTRACT | task_template.md (type section) | New bullet: when a task SPLITS/EXTRACTS substrings from text, every piece stays text; don't parse a date/number-looking fragment into datetime/number (even if an example cell looks typed), unless the instruction explicitly asks for that piece as a number/date. |
| 4 | rank 4 | CONFLICT / adherence | prompt.md (worked-example line) | Appended: when a worked-example cell contradicts the transformation the instruction describes in words (e.g. drops/alters characters the stated rule keeps), follow the stated rule literally; don't add special-case heuristics whose only purpose is to reproduce that one inconsistent cell. |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per edit; evidence + what agent would now do)
- Edit 1 → traces 39046 ("2 cells CHANGED although the expected value is the cell's own original input"; F2:F4 were given, agent overwrote them) and 51359 (same signal); 57232 ("15 cells expect an Excel error text and you wrote a computed value"; instruction said "result may be '#N/A'", agent wrote 0 fallback). The checklist's step (b) forces a diff against the original input that flags the overwritten given cells → revert; step (c) forces writing the named "#N/A" literal. Scorer compares value AND type on answer_position, so restoring originals / writing the literal makes those cells match. Reinforces cand_0001's wins (30709, 50051, 59259) which already leave cells untouched.
- Edit 2 → trace 38332: agent wrote `=IF(COUNTIF(...C{r})...)` where C{r} points at spilled `=_xlfn.UNIQUE(_xlfn._xlws.SORT(...))` cells; grader "4 cells hold an Excel error text; str where int expected". 47741: nested `_xlfn.TEXTJOIN(...TEXT(WORKDAY(...)))` → error string on all 3 copies. New knowledge tells the agent to compute the literal number/text in Python in exactly these cases → resolves to the expected typed value instead of an error string.
- Edit 3 → trace 50630: "split each sentence into three parts on ADDED/DUE"; agent parsed the due-date fragment into a datetime; grader "2 cells hold datetime where str was expected — keep the original text". New rule makes text the default for extracted pieces → matches. Aligns with existing "when the target should hold text, keep it as the original string".
- Edit 4 → trace 5192: literal rule "last number to front, preceding text to end" → `1456`+`CH02A`=`1456CH02A`, but agent stripped the trailing `A` to match the inconsistent first preview example, producing `1456CH02`; grader "text is a PREFIX of the expected text (cut short)". New clause tells it to follow the stated rule and not add the truncating heuristic → full string matches.

## Blast-radius per edit (BOUNDED unless stated)
- Edit 1: BOUNDED. Step (b) is explicitly gated to fill/compute tasks and NOT delete/sort/dedup/insert/restructure — so passing VBA/restructure tasks (94-8,160-6,185-13,448-11,458-49,435-38,587-38,110-2) are untouched. Passing fill tasks already write only the intended cells, so the diff/revert check is a no-op for them (30709,50051,59259,CF_11072, formula tasks). Step (c) only triggers when the instruction itself names a literal form, so it can't affect tasks that don't. No decision/permission rule changed.
- Edit 2: BOUNDED/additive. Only redirects to a literal when the formula is dynamic-array-based or the specified nested form AND the answer is a plain value. Passing formula tasks (44266,16511,46897,55667,56975,53167) use classic functions that recalc fine — rule does not tell them to change. prompt.md already globally prefers literals, so no new global preference introduced.
- Edit 3: BOUNDED/additive. Adds a default type only for split/extract tasks, with an explicit "unless the instruction asks for a number/date" carve-out, so a passing split task wanting a numeric piece is unaffected. Does not touch 51958-style "convert/standardize to date" (not a split task).
- Edit 4: BOUNDED/additive. Sharpens the existing worked-example guidance; only bites when an example CONTRADICTS the stated rule. No passing task's gold depends on reproducing a self-contradicting example.

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 4 parallel general-purpose read-only subagents diagnosed all 20 failing traces (groups A–D: 325-44/450-9/3911/5192; 38332/39046/50630/51359/53367; 47741/51958/55931/56427/56637; 56996/57090/57232/59743/11842). Synthesized clusters, then applied 4 edits directly.
- Prior iterations read: cand_0001 PROCESS.md + JOURNAL RESULT (ACCEPTED, fixed 30709/50051/59259, broke 73-45). Built on its leave-untouched rule by making it an unavoidable check; did NOT re-touch the bidirectional "#N/A/'-' literal" decision rule (a documented regression trap).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- Kept cand_0001's additive rules verbatim (leave-untouched, type-cast, _xlfn, mirror-existing-formula). Did not weaken or reorder them.
- Did NOT alter the bidirectional named-literal decision rule globally — only added a verification CHECK that the named literal is written when the instruction states it (narrowing, not loosening).
- Did NOT add a transpose-type-conversion rule for 56427: it conflicts with the pass-through-preserve behavior other tasks rely on (regression risk).

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- ENVIRONMENT: 73-45 (recalc infra failure — flagged INFRASTRUCTURE, cand_0001 already "broke" it via the same fault), 56996 (volatile =RANDBETWEEN source → non-deterministic). Prompt is not the defect; handed back.
- Ambiguous / inconsistent-gold / isolated logic: 325-44, 3911, 53367, 59743, 57090, 55931, 56637, 56427, 11842, 450-9 bulk row-count divergence, 51958. Not knowledge gaps — the specific intended computation/ordering isn't derivable from the instruction, so any prose rule is a guess that risks regressing passing tasks.
